_sources.workload.site_names: T14-QUALIFY-R5: five normal accounts use the revision-289 woodcutting.falador_west.n site. Their Starts (2946,3399), (2955,3399), (2952,3417), (2955,3407), (2958,3415) are inside its authored region x=2946..2958,z=3399..3417. The deterministic selection in qualify-1102/start-selection-v2/selection.json ranked native bank-reachable, standable Starts with at least two in-site trees by least resource overlap, distance from the R4E Start, separation, then coordinates; a distinct five-tree reachability matching exists. Fifteen oak accounts use the distinct woodcutting.falador_west.2 site. Its authored region x=2886..2932,z=3350..3412 has three oaks; Start (2925,3367,0) at radius 12 contains all three (crates/api/data/game-data/289.json:112059-112107; content/maps/m45_52.jm2:5249,5313,5384). Falador West bank and the outer bound x=2840..3065,z=3262..3527 remain common. Main's Chance outcomes ruling limits the route proof to workload travel, Gatherer retreat/re-approach, and fault recovery, not event-derived routes. Observed owned random-event excursions are recorded until safe re-entry; unrelated workload departures still fail. Only requirement-free adjacent same-level ordinary gates/doors can pass the route check. Death, stall, missed-work, transport, and memory gates are unchanged.
_sources.workload.food: T14-SOAK-DIAG-1102/site-safety-preflight.json:10-16 reports zero aggressive-envelope intersections in the oak radius-12 square and a nearest-envelope margin of 9 tiles. Revision-289 NPC id 172 at (2910,3337) has forced_max_hit 6, while Lobster item 379 heals 12 Hitpoints (crates/api/data/game-data/289.json npc_placements.rows, npc_names.rows and consumption). Seed one Lobster in each account's inventory plus one bank replacement; foodTarget=1. One carried Lobster heals twice the nearest static hunter's max hit. eatBelow=0 retains Gatherer's automatic half-base-HP threshold (crates/script/src/gatherer/runner.rs:1860-1863). Static scan only; dynamic threats, actual routes, interactions and bank/yield rate remain unproved.
